name: Exec Cluster E14: Session Execution (RTH, Custom Window, Morning Dip)
description: Tests: session_window with EquityRTHSession, custom session for initial balance, session .opened/.closed pulses, hold_until for session entry/exit.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER E14: Session Execution
# Tests: session_window, custom sessions, morning dip pattern
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === RTH SESSION ===
rth = session_window(session=SessionType.EquityRTHSession)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)
day_open = rth.open
rth_range = rth.high - rth.low

# === INITIAL BALANCE (first 30 min) ===
ib = session_window(
    session=Session(start='09:30', end='10:00', tz='America/New_York')
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)
ib_high = ffill_day(where(ib.closed, ib.high))
ib_low = ffill_day(where(ib.closed, ib.low))

# === MORNING DIP PATTERN ===
trade_window = session_window(
    session=Session(start='09:45', end='10:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)

dip = trade_window.open < day_open
entry = trade_window.opened and dip
exit_sig = trade_window.closed
held = hold_until(entry, exit_sig)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=25)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=2)
take_profit(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=3)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='RTH Range',
    category='Sessions',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Range', color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=rth_range)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.ClockIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='IB High', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='IB Low', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='IB Closed'
    )
)((ib_high, ib_low, ib.closed))
